sources.entry: Taskwarrior - Taskwarrior is Free and Open Source Software that manages your TODO list from your command line. It is flexible, fast, efficient, and unobtrusive. It does its job then gets out of your way. (Source Code) MIT C++

summary.name: Taskwarrior
summary.one_liner: Taskwarrior is a free, open source, command-line to-do list manager written in C++ under the MIT license.
use_cases: managing a personal todo list from the terminal
tracking tasks without leaving the command line
installing a command-line task manager on Linux or macOS
summary.what_it_does: The page is the download page for Taskwarrior. It offers the latest stable source tarball (version 3.5.0, with SHA256 checksum) and a link to the git repository. It gives CMake build and install steps for building the task program from source, and says the program must be on the PATH after install. It also lists Taskwarrior packages available in many Linux distributions, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, macOS (Homebrew and MacPorts), NixOS, and MSYS2, and links to a command reference for the older 2.5.3 release. On first run, task offers to create its configuration file and task directory.
notable: Command-line only; fast, flexible and unobtrusive todo manager
Source released under the MIT license, written in C++ and built with CMake
Available through many OS package managers and Homebrew/MacPorts
Git repository offers full source and history; development branches are flagged as risky for data
caveats: Cygwin is no longer supported; Windows users are directed to WSL
Development branches may harm data; make backups before use
Older versions are available only by contacting the project
